reasons.line: They'll want to read about you for the right reasons

stanza: Suppose my life has its plans
I choose to have women write my plan
And I have my reasons

reasons.line: Trying to sound out or guess the reasons
stanza: While over and over, rear up, stand down, lay 'round
Trying to sound out or guess the reasons
I sleep like a soldier without rest
But there is no treason where there is only lawlessness
Lawlessness
We never go to bed angry
Cause we never fight
Yeah we never go crazy
In the middle of the night
We could stay here forever
Just holding on
We both had our reasons
But our reasons are gone

reasons.line: Oh, you're a hard one, but I know that you got your reasons
stanza: Desperado, why don't you come to your senses?
You've been out ridin' fences for so long now
Oh, you're a hard one, but I know that you got your reasons
These things that are pleasin' you can hurt you somehow
So don't give me
Love with an old book of rules
That kind of love's just for fools
And I'm over it
And my reasons
For walking away
My reasons
For wanting to change
My reasons
For everything are lost with you
The drone of flying engines
Is a song so wild and blue
It scrambles time and seasons
If it gets through to you
Then your life becomes a travelogue
Of picture-postcard charms

seasons.line: Till our hearts turn like the seasons
stanza: We falter at the sight
We stumble in the mire
Fools who think they see the light
Prepare to balance on the wire
But we learn to watch together
And feed on what we see above
Till our hearts turn like the seasons
And we are acrobats of love
Shower me with your sweet love
I will bathe in every drop
Through all the seasons
Let it pour and never stop

seasons.line: Caught in the complex divorce of the seasons
stanza: Born in the year of OxyContin
Raised in the tall grass
Teen millionaire having nightmares from the camera flash
Now I'm alone on a windswept island
Caught in the complex divorce of the seasons
Won't take the call if it's the label or the radio

seasons.songTitle: Baby, I’m a Big Star Now
stanza: All these seasons
All this time
Spinning past 'til they leave you far behind
Lay me down in the circle where the spotlight shines
Because all this pleasure gets me high

seasons.line: It's a strange thing, your face seems to fade with the changing seasons
stanza: It's a strange thing, your face seems to fade with the changing seasons
Then for some reason it comes back more present than ever
Well, not your face really, more a sense of you
Even though I know it's happened, it's no more comprehensible than
If it was an abstract thing, someone else's friend, are you
Asking me for something, is there something I should do?
It's hard on your mother, she lost your little brother too
But your sister's doing good, man, she's smart, smart like you
And she'll finish her degree next year, try and find a job
I suppose she's got her head screwed on right, you don't have to worry
Is there something else, though? I mean, if there is, I'm sorry
'Cause I can't really think what you might want from me
